fundamental_bias.method: Weighted five-trading-day price trend; DXY inverted (45%), WTI crude (20%), gold (35%). Each return is capped at +/-2% before weighting.
fundamental_bias.summary: Bullish rules-based context from equally transparent trend inputs: US Dollar Index down over 5 trading days (-0.82%): a falling dollar supports gold; WTI crude oil up over 5 trading days (+4.34%): rising oil can support inflation-hedge demand; Gold futures up over 5 trading days (+0.97%): gold's own recent trend adds directional context.

disclaimer: Informational only, not investment advice. Data can be delayed or unavailable.
